verdict.rationale: Fathom's own docs say AI summaries are available instantly after each call and that it generates action items (next steps), with custom summaries on advanced plans. Nothing shows the summary's structure (key points, decisions) or that it is good enough to share without editing. Missing for 10: documented summary structure covering key points and decisions, evidence the output is share-ready without editing, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I get a structured summary right after each meeting — key points, decisions, and next steps — good enough to share without editing

citations.quote:
AI summaries instantly  
available after your call
